correctness.rationale: The local truth-table implication f(a,b,c)=c iff a=b=1-c forces alternating structure for every output with equal endpoint bits. Complementary endpoint inputs yield an exact signed-shift bijection of the other 2^(n-1) words. Each shift-coordinate orbit has a consistency parity of (n-2)t/gcd(n-1,t), yielding the exact all-t fixed count. Two separately implemented full-map checks independently verified every one-step image for n=3..14, the signed shift through n=17, and all tested fixed-iterate counts. Finite checks corroborate but do not establish the symbolic result.

value.rationale: The natural finite dynamical system has a sharp nonlinear-to-affine collapse: a full half-cube of recurrent states is conjugate to an invertible signed shift after exactly one sweep. The parity defect adds an isolated odd-length two-cycle, and the exact all-t orbit statistics and maximal period expose a qualitative distinction from earlier convergence-only work. This is a structural all-length theorem, not a numerical table or a routine restatement.
